propositions: auto-derive a culprit commit via git blame on the pre-fix state (fixing-commit~1) when closing a bug, linking caused_by to the culprit ticket if blame resolves to >50% single-dominant commit with a rebar-ticket trailer
the auto-derivation must bypass the closed-source guard by writing the caused_by link directly via _write_link_event after the bug is already closed, without blocking close on resolution failure
an explicit --caused-by <id> CLI parameter must override or supplement auto-derivation and always set the link regardless of blame ambiguity
the public library facade transition() in _lib_writes.py must thread the caused_by parameter end-to-end so library callers can set caused_by on close
auto-derivation must return None (no link) on ambiguous cases: no file_impact, no fixing commit found, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable rebar-ticket trailer
